title: Operationalizing Automated Essay Scoring: A Human-Aware Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Equalized Odds metric across score categories to measure disparities between genders, and predicting scores based on demographic features using a Histogram Gradient Boosting classifier.
Measuring disparities using the Equalized Odds metric and predicting essay scores based on the student's 'English learner' status.
Evaluating scoring disparities for 'Economically disadvantaged' students using the Equalized Odds metric across different score categories.
Comparing the Equalized Odds metric between White students and students of other races and ethnicities across multiclass essay score categories.
